opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Establish early tech with Cybernetics Core while maintaining a gateway-based production start.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high rate of first gas (97.4%) and first production (99.9%) compared to baseline (74.8% and 78.2%).
The medoid sequence shows a Gateway, then Gas, then second Gateway, then Cybernetics Core, then second Gas.
The opening has a high rate of Cybernetics Core (85.4%) compared to baseline (61.6%).
